asA: test-author starting a new round, and the stage-keeper judging the branch
iWant: rcf audit separation to refuse any stage regression except a new round right after a failed verdict
soThat: every fix round re-runs all five stages and no BUILD or DEFINE commit slips in after a passed review
description: The round state machine inside rcf audit separation.
title: The test-author and the stage-keeper see round order judged in the audit, with a failed verdict as the only road back to DEFINE

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture branch DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: (a passed review.json for its parent H), TEST: (a PASS test.json for H) and FINALISE: (rcf/fbs/ only), when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0 with "separation: PASS 5 commits (base <b7>, head <h7>): DEFINE 1, BUILD 1, REVIEW 1, TEST 1, FINALISE 1, merges 0, transition 0".

[happy] Given a fixture branch DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: (code FINDINGS), DEFINE: (the test-author's triage), BUILD:, REVIEW: (MERGE/PASS), TEST: (PASS), when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0: the regression to DEFINE: right after the failed verdict starts round two.

[failure] Given a fixture branch DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: (MERGE/PASS), BUILD: (a further code change), when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with the item "<s7> BUILD: after REVIEW: without a failed verdict (stage order is monotonic within a round)"; the same holds for a DEFINE: after a passed REVIEW: or after a TEST: PASS, and for a DEFINE: after BUILD: with no verdict between.

[failure] Given a fixture branch whose REVIEW: commit records FINDINGS and whose next commit is "BUILD: quick fix", when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with the item "<s7> BUILD: after a failed verdict; the next round starts at DEFINE:"; the same holds for a TEST: right after a TEST: FAIL.

[failure] Given a REVIEW: commit whose review.json head is not its parent, and a TEST: commit whose test.json head is not the round's reviewed head, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with "<s7> REVIEW: verdict head <x7> is not its parent <p7>" and "<s7> TEST: verdict head <x7> is not the reviewed head <H7>"; the one exception is a TEST: commit adding a FAIL test.json whose head is the commit's own parent, after a TEST PASS at H in the same round (stage-keeper ruling 3), which passes and closes the round.

[edge] Given a fixture branch REVIEW: (MERGE/PASS), TEST: (PASS), FINALISE: (a clean merge of main), FINALISE: (rcf/fbs/ only), when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0; given the same branch with a further "DEFINE: amend", or a "TEST: rerun" adding a PASS test.json, after the FINALISE: commits, it exits 4 with "<s7> DEFINE: after FINALISE: without a failed verdict (stage order is monotonic within a round)" or the same item for TEST:; given instead "TEST: merge head red" adding a FAIL test.json whose head is its parent (the FINALISE: merge) and then "DEFINE: triage", it exits 0: the FAIL closes the round and the next round starts at DEFINE: on the same branch (stage-keeper ruling 3).

[must-not] No commit message text changes a round verdict: a REVIEW: commit whose subject says MERGE but whose review.json records FINDINGS closes the round; a REVIEW: commit with no review.json is judged on classes and counts as no verdict, so it never opens TEST; and the audit never reads a verdict from anywhere but the file the commit adds.

[non-functional] Given a fixture range of 6 rounds (30 or more commits, each REVIEW: and TEST: adding a verdict file), when rcf audit separation runs, then the round judgement adds no more than one git process per verdict commit to the budget of the per-commit judgement and the run finishes within 5 seconds on the host the suite runs on (the test prints os.cpus().length and process.version).

[failure] Given a fixture branch DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: (MERGE/PASS for its parent H) and a second "REVIEW: codex" adding a review.json for its own parent, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with "<s7> REVIEW: after a passed REVIEW verdict (one REVIEW verdict per round)"; a REVIEW: commit adding no review.json before the verdict commit passes.

[failure] Given a fixture branch BUILD: then "TEST: verdict" adding a PASS test.json, with no REVIEW: commit in the range, rcf audit separation exits 4 with "<s7> TEST: verdict with no passed REVIEW verdict in the round"; the same branch whose TEST: commit adds only rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/a.json exits 0 and counts that commit as no verdict.

[edge] Given a fixture branch DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: (MERGE/PASS), TEST: (PASS at H), "TEST: strength" adding rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test-strength.json with result fail, then "DEFINE: triage", rcf audit separation exits 0: the failing record closes the round; the same branch with "BUILD: fix" after the failing record exits 4 with "<s7> BUILD: after a failed verdict; the next round starts at DEFINE:".

[edge] When rcf audit separation --help runs, then its round items list "<sha7> TEST: verdict head <x7> is not the reviewed head <H7>", the reviewed head written <H7> as TAC-4154 and AC-19703-5 write it, and no help line names the reviewed head <h7>.
